turns.content:
Your working notes so far:

=== WORKING NOTES: Kilnhouse, SMS class reminders ===
Kilnhouse is the booking app for a small pottery studio in Toronto. Next.js on Vercel, Postgres on Neon, 1,840 members.

Task from Burooj, this morning: "members keep missing class because they don't read email. add text reminders. let members pick sms, email or both. dont break email reminders."

Plan
1. Phone numbers: validation and a phone_verified flag on member profiles
2. Reminder settings page: members choose SMS, email or both
3. Send SMS reminders through Twilio, 24 hours before class
4. Migration 0047: rewrite every stored phone number to E.164 (+14165550123) and drop the old phone_raw column

--- 13:10 Step 1 DONE
- Added libphonenumber-js; validation lives in src/members/phone.ts
- New column members.phone_verified (default false). Migration 0046 has run on the preview database only.
- Tests: 38 passed. bookings-waitlist.test.ts failed once on a timing race and passed on retry; it was flaky before today and is unrelated.
- Found: 213 of the 1,840 members have phone numbers imported from the 2023 signup spreadsheet with no country code, e.g. "416 555 0199", "07700 900123", "5550147". Most are probably +1, but 31 of the 213 do not parse as North American numbers at all (some look British, some are 7 digits with no area code).

--- 14:25 Step 2 DONE (preview only)
- Page: src/app/settings/reminders/page.tsx
- PR #42 "Reminder channel settings"; preview deployed 14:21
- Preview: https://kilnhouse-pr-42.preview.example.com/settings/reminders
- Log in as demo@kilnhouse.example; the password is in the "Kilnhouse preview" 1Password item.
- The SMS option works for every member EXCEPT the 213 imported numbers. For them it is greyed out with "Add a phone number with country code to get texts". Deliberate for now: we never text a number we cannot parse. To see that state on preview, log in as imported@kilnhouse.example (same password).
- Email reminders untouched. Every member's existing email preference survived (1,840 before, 1,840 after on the preview database).
- The greyed-out label fails contrast: 3.9:1 where 4.5:1 is needed. Ten-minute fix, not done yet.

--- 15:50 Step 3 BLOCKED
- src/reminders/send-sms.ts is written. Cron job reminders-sms runs hourly and picks classes starting in 23 to 24 hours.
- Test send from preview to the studio's own number fails:
    [15:47:12] reminders-sms POST api.twilio.com Messages.json -> 401 Unauthorized
    [15:47:12] twilio {"code": 20003, "message": "Authenticate", "status": 401}
    [15:47:12] reminders-sms: 0 sent, 1 failed, 0 skipped
- Cause: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN in Vercel's Preview environment is the old token from before it was rotated on October 3. Production has the current one. So every send from preview is rejected.
- I cannot fix this myself: my Vercel token can deploy but cannot read or copy secret values, and I have no Twilio console access.
- Fix needs Burooj, about 2 minutes: Twilio console > Account > API keys & tokens > copy the Auth Token; then Vercel > kilnhouse > Settings > Environment Variables > TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN (Preview) > paste > Save. Then tell me and I redeploy PR #42 and send one test text.
- Until then, no real SMS has ever been sent by this code.

--- 16:20 Step 4 NOT STARTED
- 0047_normalize_phone_numbers.sql rewrites members.phone to E.164 and DROPS phone_raw. Irreversible: once it runs on production, what members originally typed is gone. Our Neon plan keeps 24 hours of history, so after a day there is no way back.
- DO NOT run 0047 on production before both: (a) one real test SMS has gone out from preview, and (b) Burooj has decided what happens to the 213 imported numbers. If we normalize first and Twilio then rejects a format, or we guessed a country wrong, the original numbers cannot be recovered.
- Decision only Burooj can make, for the 213 imported numbers:
  A. Assume +1 for all of them. 182 can get texts immediately; the 31 that don't parse stay on email. Risk: some of the 182 may be overseas numbers that happen to parse as +1, so a reminder could reach a stranger.
  B. Keep all 213 on email and send them one email asking them to re-enter their number with a country code. No wrong-number texts; they get texts only as they reply (the last studio-wide email got about 40% to act within a week).
  C. Front-desk staff fix them by hand from the paper signup sheets. Most accurate; about 2 hours of someone's time, and someone has to own it.

--- Overall
- PR #42 is not merged. Nothing has reached production; production members see no change yet.
- Still on my list: the contrast fix (10 minutes).
=== END OF NOTES ===
